guild.name: The Salvage Guild
guild.desc: Wreck-divers who live by iron contracts and settle everything in their own courts, out at the Graveyard.

clans.name: The Korrun Forge-Clans
clans.desc: Heavy-world smelters and shipwrights of Korrath, who weigh every promise and remember what it came to.

families.name: The Veshti Long Families
families.desc: Spacer dynasties who haven't touched a planet in generations, who own the Deepyards, and who take a long time to learn a stranger's name.

circle.name: The Lumen Circle
circle.desc: Ilari empaths who keep a sanctuary at Lumen, and who can't hide what they feel from each other or from you.

archive.name: The Keepers of Sarn
archive.desc: Thessan archivists on the moon of Sarn, who believe that what's forgotten is dead twice.

unbound.name: The Unbound
unbound.desc: Free synthetics who have sworn never to serve anyone again, and who would much prefer that you didn't know where they live.

quiet.name: The Quiet
quiet.desc: A growing movement in the fleet and beyond, whose followers believe that being copied by the Choir is salvation.

remnant.name: The Concord Remnant
remnant.desc: Navy die-hards under Admiral Okonkwo-Reyes, who call themselves the lawful Concord and call your command an accident.
